brief: 5 signs you're a people pleaser and how to stop today.

slots.title: FIVE SIGNS YOU ARE A PEOPLE PLEASER
YOU APOLOGIZE FOR EVERYTHING
slots.body: Saying sorry when you did nothing wrong erodes your self-worth. Stop over-apologizing and save your words for real mistakes.

slots.title: YOU CAN'T SAY NO
slots.body: You agree to plans you hate just to avoid disappointing others. Remember, every yes to them is a no to yourself.

slots.title: YOU NEED CONSTANT VALIDATION
slots.body: You fish for compliments and crumble without outside approval. Build internal confidence by validating your own efforts first.

slots.title: YOU SUPPRESS YOUR OWN NEEDS
slots.body: You prioritize everyone else's comfort while yours goes ignored. Start small by naming one need you will honor today.

slots.title: YOU FEEL RESPONSIBLE FOR OTHERS
slots.body: You twist yourself into knots trying to keep everyone happy. Their emotions are their job, not your assignment to fix.

slots.title: HOW TO STOP TODAY
slots.body: Awareness is the first step toward real change. Choose one boundary this week and enforce it without guilt or excuses.
